name: Rehearsal Loop
tagline: Loop any section of a song with one tap, and practice along until you've got it.
summary: Play a song from Apple Music or your own library, tap a big button at the start and end of the part you're learning, and Rehearsal Loop plays it over and over. Songs you own can slow down without changing pitch. It plays through your speaker, headphones or AirPlay, and remembers your loop for every song. Rehearsal Loop Pro shows you the notes and chords of the loop, and lets you play along with the band with any part muted.
requires: iOS 17 or later · Apple Music or your own music

steps.title: Pick a song
steps.body: Use whatever's playing in the Music app, or search Apple Music, your playlists and your own songs.

steps.title: Tap at the start
steps.body: Hit the big Loop button where the section begins. That's point A.

steps.title: Tap at the end
steps.body: Tap again where it ends. That's point B, and the loop starts right away.

steps.title: Practice
steps.body: Play along as many times as you need. Tap to pause the loop, tap again to bring it back, or fine-tune either point to the hundredth of a second.

features.title: One big button
features.body: Set A, set B, loop on, loop off, all from one button you can hit without looking. Headphone and lock-screen buttons work too.

features.title: Apple Music and your own songs
features.body: Loop anything in Apple Music at normal speed, with a short gap at the loop point. Songs you own and files you import loop with no gap at all, even over AirPlay.

features.title: Slow it down
features.body: Play your own songs from 50 to 150 percent speed without changing pitch, and shift the key by up to 12 semitones if you need to.

features.title: Fine-tune and save loops
features.body: Drag a point under a fixed line on the waveform, pinch to zoom and nudge by tiny steps. With Pro, keep several named loops per song, each with its own tempo.

features.title: See the notes
features.body: Pro shows the loop's key, chords and notes as sheet music, tab or a piano roll, written for your instrument. Fix any note, hear it back, and share it as MusicXML or MIDI. Apple Music loops work by listening through the microphone.

features.title: Play along with the band
features.body: Pro splits the loop into vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano and the rest, right on your iPhone. Mute your part and play it yourself, or solo it to hear it clearly. For songs you own.
